articles.title: GHSA: MCP TypeScript SDK: Experimental tasks were not tied to the session that created them
articles.summary:
### Summary
In affected versions, the experimental tasks feature (`taskStore`) did not check which session created a task. Clients sharing one `InMemoryTaskStore` could list, read and cancel each other's tasks.

Experimental tasks are deprecated. The 2026-07-28 specification replaced them with a redesigned extension. The best course of action is to stop using them.

articles.title: GHSA: ApostropheCMS: Missing Authorization on Notification PATCH/DELETE Endpoints
articles.summary:
## Summary

The notification module exposes `PATCH` and `DELETE` REST endpoints that perform operations directly on the underlying MongoDB collection without verifying that the requester is authenticated or owns the target notification.

As a result, an unauthenticated attacker who obtains a valid notification ID can modify or permanently delete another user's notification.
